notes.title: 1.11 emergency patch
notes.content: Fixed a timing system bug in the "Super Drift Blade" special track.

notes.title: Bundle and content collaboration with Super Drift Blade!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582777/c79d970d4fdc7ee738d1eabbbf918bbec64f47cb.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582777/2a392c39bfd043a522112c05784de05533865df5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Drift Day and Super Slither bundle is now available! Drift Day also features new themed tracks, and the gameplay ties in with the hack-and-slash theme of Super Slither. Use precise vehicle control to eliminate all enemies within the time limit!
